methods.regression: Multivariate OLS on six shocks, with and without SPY market-return control; HAC Bartlett standard errors and asymptotic 90% intervals
methods.confidence: High: CI excludes zero, >=504 daily/104 weekly observations, >=2 folds, sign agreement >=80%, holdout correlation >=0.2. Medium: excludes zero, >=180 daily/40 weekly, >=1 fold, sign agreement >=60%. Otherwise low.
methods.shrinkage: Stock weight = n/(n+252) times beta^2/(beta^2+HAC_SE^2); sector proxy target. Unshrunk OLS CI retained; shrunk bands conditional, not calibrated coverage.
methods.holdout: Preferred 504/126 daily or 104/26 weekly train/test, non-overlapping forward tests. Short history uses 120/60 daily or 26/13 weekly, explicitly flagged. Same-period shocks; not next-day predictions.
methods.limits: Association is not causation. Current constituents/caps create survivorship and look-ahead weighting. Revised macro series, asynchronous closes, no real-time vintages, unadjusted multiple comparisons, omitted variables and unstable coefficients prevent predictive claims.
methods.weekly: Compound percent returns and percent factors; sum bp/point changes across complete observed equity weeks only. No missing date is replaced by zero.
methods.reasons: Every reason is a deterministic template; no model-generated numerical claims. Scenario CI describes coefficient uncertainty, not a prediction interval.
